external_entities.name: colleagues
external_entities.description: People who use applications and sign in through the identity broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.

external_entities.name: franchise colleagues
external_entities.description: Colleagues from franchise stores who authenticate through their own identity provider.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: own devices at home
external_entities.description: Devices used by colleagues to sign in from home.
external_entities.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

external_entities.name: franchise stores
external_entities.description: Franchise stores whose colleagues are allowed to use the sign-in system.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

external_entities.name: own identity provider
external_entities.description: The identity provider used by franchise colleagues to vouch for them to the broker.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them
external_entities.notes: The source does not state which colleagues this provider is allowed to vouch for.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, signs tokens, provides public signing material, synchronizes group membership, and writes sign-ins to an audit log.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker. The broker runs on the corporate network.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses tokens to authorize changing prices and voiding transactions for every store.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications. It also runs on the corporate network.
processes.notes: The console does not check which store the colleague belongs to, so a store-manager token works against every store.

processes.name: HR system
processes.description: System from which group-membership changes and leaver status are pulled overnight.
processes.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: Store holding the signing key used by the identity broker to sign tokens.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_stores.notes: The source does not state whether the key store is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and the groups they are in.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_stores.notes: The source does not state whether the directory is encrypted where it sits.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: Log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route. The source does not state whether the log is encrypted where it sits.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Colleagues sign in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are
data_flows.notes: The source does not state whether colleagues are asked for a second factor.

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Franchise colleagues sign in through their own identity provider.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for franchise colleagues to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in
data_flows.notes: The source does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token to a signed-in colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.notes: The token carries the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.
data_flows.data_description: token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: present token
data_flows.description: A colleague presents the issued token to the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every application takes that token and decides what the colleague may do from the groups in it.
data_flows.data_description: token containing staff id and group membership

data_flows.name: fetch public key
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the broker's signing key.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.

data_flows.name: store signing key
data_flows.description: The identity broker keeps the signing key in the key store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_flows.name: maintain directory
data_flows.description: The identity broker maintains its directory of colleagues and group membership.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The identity broker pulls group-membership and leaver changes from the HR system overnight.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night

data_flows.name: write sign-ins
data_flows.description: The identity broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.notes: The source does not state what the log records or whether it covers the franchise route.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network on which the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: own devices at home
trust_boundaries.description: The separate environment of colleagues' own devices used from home.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home

trust_boundaries.name: franchise stores
trust_boundaries.description: The franchise environment whose colleagues use their own identity provider.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: We also let the franchise stores in.

assumptions.assumption: The directory's stated contents—colleagues and their group membership—contain personal information and are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The directory contains colleagues and the groups they are in.

assumptions.assumption: The key store's stated contents—the token-signing key—are confidential.
assumptions.basis: The key store contains a signing key used to sign tokens.
